postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve the postcode as exactly three digits. It identifies a postal area and routing context, not a recipient, premise, building, or delivery guarantee.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Use the pinned Byggðastofnun postcode register and geographic coverage for official polygon or multipolygon geometry. Preserve register edition, effective decision lineage, metadata and rights; never silently replace it with retired IS 50V postcode rows, statistical geography or AGID cells.
postal_system.address_rule: Use HMS Staðfangaskrá for address identifiers, house number and suffix, postcode assignment at an address point, coordinate type, review status, and accuracy.
postal_system.building_rule: IS 50V buildings are topographic geometry at 1:50,000. Proximity or containment alone does not create an exact HMS address-to-building link.
postal_system.rural_rule: Rural service classification and delivery origin are operational context. A rural postcode can be multipart and does not identify a single road, farm, or building.
postal_system.postbox_rule: A user-selected Póstbox or post-office collection point is a delivery preference and point facility. It does not change the premise postcode or create a surrounding postcode polygon.

exception_classes.rule: Return pinned Byggðastofnun postcode geometry and keep Pósturinn routing classification and HMS address assignments as separate evidence.
Preserve multipart geometry, rural distribution class, delivery origin, island components, and temporal version without inferring a farm or building.
Return the selected facility point and service context without overwriting the premise postcode or inferring residence at the facility.
Preserve whether HMS coordinates represent estimated building centre, main entrance, driveway, parcel interior, or estimated building site.
An IS 50V building near an HMS point remains candidate geometry until a stable source-backed relationship resolves ambiguity.
Version Byggðastofnun register decisions and areas, Pósturinn classifications, HMS addresses, buildings, municipalities, and statistics with separate valid and known times.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release, digest, reuse terms, attribution, geographic scope, and transformation method.
Byggðastofnun postcode assignment and geometry, Pósturinn routing, HMS address evidence, IS 50V building geometry, Statistics Iceland context, and AGID indexes remain separate.
Coordinate type, review status, estimated accuracy, HEINUM, HNITNUM, and optional MATSNR remain available for every promoted address assertion.
A displayed building has one coherent source-backed address path; nearest or containing IS 50V geometry remains a derived candidate.
Polygon and multipolygon geometry is valid, bounded, versioned, and checked for unexplained gaps, overlaps, and missing inhabited address points.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-reviewed snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
